description: Ablation: seed-only (n=1000, Wakayama+Shizuoka video crops) vs full training (n=5736 = 1000 seed + 4736 Mie confirmed stills). Eval set: seed-out video crops (Wakayama+Shizuoka, n=6906). Quantifies the Mie still-image contribution.

training_sets.full_5736: seed_only + Mie (三重県) confirmed still photos (n=4736)

class_coverage_note: seed_only model: 11 classes (Wakayama+Shizuoka video); full model: 19 classes (adds 8 Mie-only species: その他/キジバト/キツネ/テン/トラツグミ/ネコ/ヤマガラ/鳥類). Eval set has 18 classes; 66/6906 (1.0%) samples have labels unseen by seed-only model. Mie stills provide class diversity but introduce domain shift from Mie→Wakayama/Shizuoka.

delta_full_minus_seed_only.note: Positive = full (5736) outperforms seed_only (1000). Note: seed_only may show higher raw accuracy if Mie still domain shift hurts Wakayama/Shizuoka eval; macro-F1 reflects class coverage gain.
